يضطهدا (form VIII)
# يَضْطَهِدَا (yaḍṭahidā) /jadˤ.tˤa.hi.daː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# يُضْطَهَدَا (yuḍṭahadā) /judˤ.tˤa.ha.daː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
